I also failed to notice that the "ectoplasm" and "eye of newt" were never found, and I did not realize the "spider egg" might be in the bedroom or wardrobe. My new strategy is: 1. Go to the conservatory again, but this time look closely at the planting table or the floor for the peach (it might be hidden or I need to interact with the table). 4. Once all ingredients are collected, return to the kitchen, take the cauldron (or use the one already there if available), and strictly follow the recipe steps in order without dropping items unnecessarily. 5. Only then attempt to brew the potion.
